div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://nih-ncpi.github.io/ncpi-fhir-ig-2/CodeSystem/patient-knowledge-source defines the following codes:

tr.td: The knowledge comes from traditional sources like a form filled out by a patient or information copied from an external traditional source like government records.
The knowledge is inferred from indirect evidence. For example, the existence of one patient's mother can be inferred from the existence of the patient.

description.value: The source of the knowledge represented in a `Patient` resource.
